chapter: Jump for Joy and the Puerto Rico honour
title: No part in the Jump for Joy music
summary: He repeats that he did not work on the music, though Duke and Strayhorn were writing at the Dunbar Hotel.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Like I said before, there's not much I can say about "Jump for Joy", what happened or anything like that.
I see, okay. And you don't remember working on any of the music for it?
Strayhorn was around then, and Duke and Strayhorn were staying at the -- I guess the whole band was staying at the Dunbar Hotel.
I know they told me that Duke and Strayhorn were working on the music for it at the Dunbar right up until the time it opened.
No, I don't believe I worked with the "Jump for Joy" thing.
